; REQ: LANG-1471 LANG-1472 LANG-1473
Red [Title: "Greeter"]

greet: func [name [string!] /times n [integer!]] [
    text: rejoin ["Hello, " name "!^/"]
    either times [loop n [print text]] [print text]
]

config: make object! [name: "world" count: 3]
greet/times config/name config/count
multi: {Multi-line
string}
print [true false none 3.14 #FF]
